setting.Labels.ExtraSlots.description: How many extra labels each shelf label gets, up to 3. The host decides for everyone. Pictures of hidden labels stay in the save and come back when the labels are shown again.
setting.Look.Spacing.description: Gap between the labels in meters.
setting.Labels.DefaultPlacement.description: Where extra labels go on shelves without a placement of their own. Every shelf label can get its own with the hotkey below. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Look.PlacementHotkey.description: Look at a shelf label or its extra label and press to switch: freer side, right, left, below, no extra labels. Every player can do it, the host keeps it in the save.
setting.Labels.HideStands.description: Extra labels on shelves without a choice of their own are shown without the wooden stand under the frame. The game's own label always keeps it. The host decides for everyone.
setting.Look.StandHotkey.description: Look at a shelf label or its extra label and press to show or hide the wooden stand of its extra labels. Every player can do it, the host keeps it in the save.

message.lookAtLabel: Look at a shelf label first
message.noHost: The host does not have Shelf Labels
message.standUnsupported: The stand of this label cannot be removed
